before: The font substitution notice listed only faces that text renders in, so a missing symbol face that a private-use symbol needs was not listed.
after: The notice also lists symbol faces whose glyph has no Unicode equivalent. Metafile pictures in PDF export take the picture's brightness and contrast, and a metafile with a malformed record reports a diagnostic.
reason: Both changes only read the document: a local font notice derived from the tree, and PDF export. Shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged.
